@Moiz Syed also thinking, since the list of topics could be very long, we probably need to add a landmark (orange) container around each of two groups:
1. items C-E and buttons 2-4 => name: [Followed Topics via aria-labelledby]; role: list
2. items G-H and buttons 5-6 => name: [Blocked Topics via aria-labelledby]; role: list

Each row, i.e. C+2, E+4, etc. would be a listitem (<li>) and the keyboard navigation between buttons within that group would be arrow navigation (the annotations component includes a toggle to change purple to turquoise, AFAIK). Basically, from the "<" back button "tab" would get us to the button 2 (Business Following) then "tab" to the button 5 (Entertainment Unblock), then "Arrow Down" to 6 (Sports Unblock).

This would announce the heading when focus is entering the group and would announce a list length and position for a user to navigate.
